strings.dialogue.npc.guard.greeting: Vera Kane, Aegis Compact. This perimeter is under observation.
strings.dialogue.npc.guild_representative.farewe: The board refreshes as capabilities change.
strings.dialogue.npc.guild_representative.greeti: Talia Nox. I coordinate field contracts for the Academy network.
strings.dialogue.npc.opponent.greeting: Wrong place. Leave before I make the decision for you.
strings.dialogue.npc.pilot.greeting: Soren Vale. I fly the local lanes when the weather permits.
strings.dialogue.npc.scientist.greeting: Dr. Eren Sol. The local biosphere is more complex than the first survey suggested.
strings.dialogue.npc.technician.greeting: Mara Quill. Field systems and repair diagnostics are my department.
strings.dialogue.npc.trader.greeting: Frontier Exchange is open. I can route trade or contracts.
strings.dialogue.npc.traveler.greeting: Yun Ardent. I thought this route would be quieter.
strings.dialogue.trader.ilia_voss.farewell: Safe travels. The market will remember every transaction.
strings.dialogue.trader.ilia_voss.greeting: Frontier Exchange online. Trade, contracts and local market data are available.
strings.dialogue_option.npc.pilot.flight.text: Tell me about the local approach.
strings.dialogue_option.npc.scientist.protect.te: I am here to secure your field work.
strings.dialogue_option.npc.technician.repair.co: Repair diagnostics shared; first useful interaction improves reputation.
strings.dialogue_option.npc.traveler.protect.tex: I can cover your route from here.
strings.dialogue_option.npc.traveler.story.text: What did you see on the road?
